scene1.intro: I am Mary, and I will guide you through a tiny VN-Sutra demo.
scene1.introduction: Before we start, what should I call you?
scene1.correctGuess: You left the default name in place. Efficient.
scene1.maryIntro: Good. I am Mary, and this is a miniature story built entirely from actions.
scene1.question: So, what is VN-Sutra to you?
scene1.wrongAnswer: Bold answer. Not correct, but memorable.
scene1.rightAnswer: Exactly. A small SDK that lets the scene do the talking.
scene1.question2: Now watch how the scene changes with just a few actions.

scene2.makeScenes: The same character, a different background, and a different mood.
scene2.addAssets: A scene is still just a list of actions, but the result can feel alive.
scene2.movement: A little motion goes a long way when the scene is this small.
scene2.question: What should I show you next?
scene2.characters: You picked characters. Expression and pose are the fastest way to change the beat.
scene2.charactersFollowup: Sprites and outfits stay readable because they are part of the script.
scene2.grayscale: You picked visual effects. A filter can change the tone of the whole scene.
scene2.grayscaleReset: Even strong effects stay easy to follow when they are declarative.
scene2.bgGrayscale: The background can shift too, not just the character.
scene2.bgGrayscaleReset: And when the effect ends, the story keeps moving.
scene2.explanation: You picked story flow. Choices, storage, and jumps are how the demo remembers itself.
scene2.docs: Nothing here needs special code paths, just a clean action list.
scene2.goodbye: Now I will close the tour and take us back to the room.

scene3.return: We are back where we started, but the scene has more context now.
scene3.characters: You picked characters. Mood and motion stay flexible when they live in the script.
scene3.effects: You picked effects. Short flashes can carry a lot of energy.
scene3.flow: You picked flow. That is the backbone of a playable demo.
scene3.recap: That is the point of VN-Sutra: keep the story readable and the engine invisible.
scene3.multiChoicePrompt: Which demo details do you want to keep in mind?
scene3.nextStepPrompt: What do you want to do next?
scene3.nextDocs: Good call. The docs are the fastest way to go deeper.
scene3.nextChapters: Browse the chapters if you want to jump around the structure.
scene3.nextReplay: Replaying the demo is useful too. It makes the flow easier to see.
scene3.final: That is enough for a starter demo. The rest is yours.
